about: Fixture snapshots used by the Vendor role preview (project/Main.dc.html, static world() and preset()). Design sample data only — separate from application data and not a seed for the app. Provenance says where each fact comes from.

provenanceKey.v46: taken unchanged from the frozen v46 Vendor boards (B5-01 … B5-08) and their handoff JSON
provenanceKey.v46-derived: computed from v46 facts without adding information (for example a revision number of 1 for a first submission)
provenanceKey.illustrative: invented for this design so a demo can run; not a sample fact, replace freely
provenanceKey.treatment: a v46 fact shown differently to the Vendor because a later owner interim or this brief requires it

uniqueNameRule.alsoChecked: the Vendor's own experiment names; case-insensitive (OD-B5-04 safe treatment)
uniqueNameRule.provenance: v46 (VX.taken, minus the Vendor's own names, which are checked from the records)

compositeWallRecords.rule: “Composite Wall Conduction” (published catalogue experiment, not this Vendor's) and “Conduction Through a Composite Wall” (SUB-0077, this Vendor's) stay two separate records while the duplicate-content decision is open (OD-B5-09). No merge and no duplicate rule.
compositeWallRecords.whereSeen: SUB-0077 in the record, list, Overview and history; “Composite Wall Conduction” only as the name-already-used message on VE-03

The record itself is unchanged; only the Vendor-facing label differs.

step1.name: Natural Convection from a Vertical Plate
step1.summary: Heat a vertical plate in still air and relate its heat transfer coefficient to the plate temperature.
step1.description: Learners set the plate temperature, read the air temperature beside the plate at several heights and compare the measured heat transfer coefficient with the free-convection correlation for a vertical plate.

step2.browserAndComputer: A current browser on a laptop or desktop

documents: Lab handout — Natural Convection from a Vertical Plate.pdf

fillSampleAnswers.note: used only by the reviewer-only Fill sample answers button; reviewers can type their own

SUB-0081.AR_device: Android phones and tablets that support ARCore, or iPhones and iPads that support ARKit
SUB-0081.AR_install: Install the build named above on each phone or tablet, open it and allow camera access. Point the camera at a flat, well-lit table to place the heated plate.

SUB-0074.summary: Cool a heated cylinder in still air and water, and test when the lumped-capacitance model holds.

revisionFixes.note: Fill sample answers in revise mode; SUB-0074's fix is its v46 one-sentence summary

documentPool.why: Add document attaches the next sample file name; nothing is uploaded (OD-B5-11). Composite Wall names are v46.

packageFileNames.value: <experiment>-<format>-1.0.zip style sample names for “attach the package file” (v46 VX.files pattern)
packageFileNames.why: stands in for the package reference; no upload or processing service (T-14 provisional)

helpReport.title: the text typed in What happened?
helpReport.why: first report reference in this preview; SUP-0181 is not used anywhere else in the pack

recentWindow.why: “Changed in the last 7 days” window is a sample choice (OD-B5-13)

formatsMixedPreset.why: a new draft at step 2 with WEB complete and AR partly filled (device and install notes empty, so the AR block shows “2 still needed”); shows a complete and an incomplete delivery block side by side (board VE-04-two-formats)

derivedViews.provenance: v46-derived: computed from the records above; no new facts

overviewCounts.value: With you 2 (1 returned · 1 draft) · In review 2 · Published 1 · Read-only 1
overviewCounts.rule: With you = returned + drafts; In review = submitted, with the Academic Reviewer, re-check, with the Content Manager; Read-only shows only when there is one

recentActivity.value: the five newest history entries across the records, newest first; “Created” entries are left out
recentActivity.rule: each row opens its record; nothing new is logged

statusLine.value: one plain line under each status pill, for example “By the Academic Reviewer on 24 Aug” or “Saved at step 2 of 4 · only you can see it”
statusLine.rule: dates and roles come from each record (HANDOFF.md §2)
